quotes.text: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
quotes.author: Alan Kay
quotes.commentary: The ultimate form of agency. Not waiting for permission, not forecasting trends—just building what should exist.

quotes.text: Make the complex simple, but not simpler.
quotes.author: Dan Abramov
quotes.commentary: A reminder that simplification has a floor. The goal isn't minimal lines of code, but minimal cognitive load.

quotes.text: The most dangerous thought you can have as a creative person is to think you know what you're doing.
quotes.author: Bret Victor
quotes.commentary: Stay a beginner. Expertise can become a prison—the best ideas come from naive questions.

principles.statement: Frameworks should be discovered, not invented.
shapedBy: Years of watching invented abstractions fail
React's emergence from Facebook's actual needs
principles.reasoning: Good frameworks emerge from solving real problems repeatedly. Invented frameworks solve imaginary problems elegantly.
Specs describe what you think you want. Demos reveal what you actually need. Show me, don't tell me.

principles.statement: Build tools for thought, not tools for output.
principles.reasoning: The best tools don't just produce artifacts—they change how you think about the problem space.

people.name: Bret Victor
admire: Demos that change how you see the world
Unwilling to accept the status quo

people.name: Alan Kay
admire: Invented the future he wanted to see
Objects were about messaging, not data
